title: NeoSwitch — Keep Claude Code. Switch your models.
description: NeoSwitch runs a small local proxy so Claude Code can use Gemini 4 Neon while keeping its commands, permissions, tools, MCP servers and hooks.
og_description: Use Gemini 4 Neon in Claude Code through a local Anthropic-compatible proxy. Per project, loopback only, open source.
og_image_alt: NeoSwitch: Keep Claude Code. Switch your models. Claude Code to a 127.0.0.1 proxy to Gemini 4 Neon.
jsonld_description: A Claude Code plugin and local Anthropic-compatible proxy that lets Claude Code use Gemini 4 Neon while keeping its commands, permissions, tools, MCP servers and hooks.
hero_lede: NeoSwitch lets Claude Code run on Gemini 4 Neon. Your commands, permissions, tools, skills, MCP servers and hooks stay exactly as they are; a small local proxy translates requests for the model behind them.
how_sub: Claude Code still owns the session, permissions, tool execution and CLAUDE.md. NeoSwitch sits on loopback and speaks the Anthropic Messages API on one side and Gemini on the other.
node_client_desc: Same CLI, slash commands, skills, MCP servers, hooks and /resume.
node_proxy_desc: Anthropic-compatible endpoint. Random access token, no prompt or credential logging, no remote relay.
node_upstream_desc: Through the official genai SDK, or the unmodified local agy acp process.
why_sub: A model switch for people who already like how Claude Code works.
why_workflow_desc: You still run Claude Code. Nothing to relearn, nothing to migrate.
why_project_desc: Route one project to Gemini and leave the rest on Anthropic.
why_local_desc: Loopback only. OAuth tokens stay inside agy; NeoSwitch never reads them.
why_honest_desc: What works, what is partial and what is missing is listed below. No silent fallback.
cmp_sub: A native plugin built for keeping your normal Claude Code setup, rather than replacing it with a separate desktop app or global proxy.
cmp_th_managers_ex: e.g. CC Switch, Claude Code Router
cmp_setup_ns: Native Claude Code plugin — no desktop app or server to manage
cmp_setup_mgr: Separate desktop app managing configs across many CLIs
cmp_setup_prx: Standalone Node.js proxy server + Web UI
cmp_scope_ns: One session at a time (/neoswitch:on, /neoswitch:off); other windows stay on Claude
cmp_scope_mgr: Global provider switching or shared local router
cmp_features_ns: Kept intact — no ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN set, so claude.ai connectors and auto mode checks keep working
cmp_features_mgr: Managed through external config or router
cmp_signin_ns: Uses your Google account through official agy — never reads, stores, or replays OAuth tokens; agy's own tools are blocked
cmp_signin_mgr: Primarily API keys and third-party relays (no agy integration)
cmp_signin_prx: Stores or reads local OAuth tokens to call private endpoints directly
cmp_best_ns: Keeping your normal Claude Code setup and switching individual sessions to Gemini 4 Neon
cmp_best_mgr: Managing many CLIs, API keys, relays, and MCPs in one place
cmp_best_prx: Multi-account rotation, Windows, or running Claude models via Antigravity
start_sub: Requires Claude Code. Go is optional: with it the plugin builds its binary from source on first use, without it the plugin downloads the matching release binary and verifies its checksum. For Antigravity OAuth, /neoswitch:login installs Google's official agy CLI when it is missing.
step2_desc: In the project that should use Neon. To use a Gemini API key instead, set it under /plugin → neoswitch → Gemini API key and run /neoswitch:on.
step3_desc: Reopen Claude Code in that project. The session header may still show a Claude model label; the status command shows the real upstream.
cred_sub: Run neoswitch doctor on any path. It looks the model up, runs a one-line generation and names the failing step if something is wrong.
cred_oauth_signin: Google account through the official agy CLI
cred_oauth_notes: The plugin's default flow. Read the warning below first.
cred_api_notes: Access to Gemini 4 Neon depends on your key.
cred_vertex_notes: Access depends on your project and region.
warn_body: The Google Antigravity Terms of Service (section 6) treat accessing Antigravity through third-party software as a breach, and Google may suspend or terminate the Antigravity accounts involved. Routing Claude Code through Antigravity OAuth falls under that rule. Use it only if you accept that risk for the account you sign in with; otherwise use a Gemini API key or Vertex AI.
compat_sub: How well Claude Code's features work depends on how well the model follows its tool protocol. This has been exercised in everyday coding use, not by an automated end-to-end suite.
tools_acp: Partial: tool-call JSON arrives whole, not streamed
tokens_api: Reported; estimated on the Developer API
compat_note: Not supported on either path: server tools such as code execution, URL image and document sources, and Claude thinking blocks. Claude Code's WebSearch works when you sign in with Google (Antigravity), which searches with Google; it does not work with a Gemini API key. Full contract in docs/protocol-contract.md.
cmds_sub: Routing changes apply to new sessions; the current session keeps its connection.
cmd_login: Sign in with Antigravity OAuth and enable this project's route
cmd_status: Show the route and daemon state
cmds_note: Prefer a standalone binary? Builds for macOS, Linux and Windows are on the Releases page, and neoswitch serve works with any Anthropic-compatible client.
